messages:
alexa: quick sync: we've seen p50 regressions when router falls back to cheaper model that the Dedicated pool hasn't prewarmed. want to define a deterministic admit handshake between router and pool manager.
tom: agree. current router picks by cost/latency guess; it shouldn't assume capacity. propose router sends ranked candidates + requested SLO (p50_ms). pool manager answers GRANT/DEFER/DENY fast.
li: for DEFER include ETA (ms). router policy: wait if ETA < caller_max_wait (default 150ms) else try next candidate. GRANT returns a short-lived token with ttl and max_concurrency.
alexa: token semantics: must be redeemed within usage_window or reclaimed. tokens signed HMAC so router can verify locally. autoscaler keeps authoritative state.
tom: perf note: /admit endpoint must be <20ms median. implement in-memory occupancy estimate + async warmers.
li: monitoring: admit_latency, grant_rate, defer_rate, deny_rate, token_expiry_rate. alert if deny_rate > 1% for premium tenants.
ops-bot: deploy note: admit-service canary scheduled, health-checks enabled.
